rationale: hammernik-claude-agentic: epochs=12, lr=0.0005, vn_T=5, vn_n_filters=16, vn_kernel=11, vn_lambda_init=0.005, batch_size=1, train_n=50, val_n=5, rationale=iter-10: KNOB=vn_n_filters: 24→16 (untested smaller). T=5 confirmed sweet (T=6 collapsed, T=7 regressed); filters=32 crashed; tested filters=24 ceiling at 0.0621. Hypothesis: smaller RBF activation grid (16) may be the sweet spot at T=5 — less overfit potential, simpler regularization landscape.
